# Orangeville General Contractor — General Contractor Services Leads, Orangeville, Ontario

> Connects Orangeville, Ontario homeowners and businesses needing general contracting and renovation work with a single vetted, exclusive local contractor. Part of the WeProvideLeads network of local-service lead generation sites.

This site is a lead-generation and referral service, not a contracting company itself. Requests submitted through the contact form are matched with one qualified, exclusive contractor serving the area.

## Services
- Home Renovations: Kitchens, bathrooms, basements, and whole-home makeovers handled from design through final walkthrough.
- Additions & Extensions: Code-compliant home additions and bump-outs that blend seamlessly with your existing structure.
- Framing & Structural: Load-bearing wall removal, floor systems, and structural modifications done to Ontario Building Code.
- Basement Finishing: Transform an unfinished basement into liveable, permitted living space.
- Kitchen & Bath Remodels: Full gut renovations or targeted updates — cabinetry, tile, plumbing rough-ins, and finishing.
- General Repairs: From minor fixes to major repairs, one call covers it.

## Service area
Orangeville, Shelburne, Grand Valley, Erin, Mono, Caledon Village
